Rich fixture

This document exercises every asset kind mq can surface. It has headings at several levels, paragraphs long enough to trigger the trim marker, tables, lists, code, images, a figure, an inline SVG, and skipped media.

The second paragraph exists so that a paragraph-unit trim has something to hide. It rambles on for a couple of sentences. Here is one more sentence to be safe about sentence-unit trimming as well.
